valuation.method: Forward EV/Revenue + Net Cash (FY2027E revenue viewed at the 12-month target date, 404.6M common shares outstanding as of Oct 30, 2026, ~$5.0B net cash from $8.0B cash/investments less $3.0B 0% convertible notes due 2032)

bear.driver: Respiratory franchise stagnates and intismeran autogene (mRNA-4157) faces FDA review delay, keeping cash burn elevated against ~$4.0B 2027 cash cost guidance.
bear.assumption: FY2027E revenue $2.0B at 22.0x EV/Revenue + $4.5B net cash ($48.5B equity / 404.6M shares)

base.driver: Intismeran autogene files with the FDA in late 2026 for a 2027 adjuvant melanoma launch alongside mFLUSIVA and international COVID-19/respiratory sales.
base.assumption: FY2027E revenue $2.6B at 31.5x EV/Revenue + $5.0B net cash ($86.9B equity / 404.6M shares)

bull.driver: Rapid intismeran autogene commercial uptake in melanoma and broader respiratory/mCOMBRIAX rollout accelerate path to sustained operating leverage.
bull.assumption: FY2027E revenue $3.2B at 36.0x EV/Revenue + $6.0B net cash ($121.2B equity / 404.6M shares)

valuation.implied_by_close: At $2.6B base FY2027E revenue and $5.0B net cash, the $223.37 close implies ~32.8x EV/Revenue (~$85.4B EV); the wide analyst target range ($77-$305) reflects dispersion from ~10x to ~46x EV/Revenue.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of FY2027E EV/Revenue multiple moves the base target by ~$6.43 (3.0 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: FDA submission and acceptance of intismeran autogene (mRNA-4157) in resected high-risk melanoma, plus FY2027 revenue vs. $4.0B cash cost guidance.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 / FY2026 earnings release and year-end 2026 FDA filing update for intismeran autogene.

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings on Nov 6, 2026 ($1.31B revenue, $0.38 GAAP EPS) and positive Phase 3 INTerpath-001 melanoma data, Goldman Sachs raised its target to $195 (Neutral) and Piper Sandler raised to $305 (Overweight) on Nov 9, 2026. Street targets remain highly dispersed ($77-$305) because bears (e.g., J.P. Morgan at $77, TD Cowen at $90) focus on ~$4.0B/year cash costs through 2030, whereas bulls price in blockbuster oncology commercialization.
